title: Maximal Total Quantum Dimension at Bounded Rank in WZW Modular Tensor Categories
summary: We determine the maximal torus topological entanglement entropy (TEE) at bounded torus ground-state degeneracy within simply connected untwisted Wess--Zumino--Witten theories. For a fixed modular tensor category $\mathcal C$, maximization over normalized torus ground states gives $\max_ψΓ_{T^2}(ψ)=2\log{\mathcal D(\mathcal C)}$, attained in particular by the vacuum-flux state. The remaining problem is therefore to maximize total $\mathcal D$ at bounded categorical rank.
